name: Host Domination Booking Engine: Calendar Sync & Reservation System
author: Host Domination

sections.description:
Host Domination Booking Engine: Calendar Sync & Reservation System helps accommodation hosts show availability, receive direct booking requests and synchronize external iCal feeds from booking platforms.

Main features:
* Availability calendar shortcode.
* Direct booking request form.
* iCal feed import for external calendars.
* Internal booking management.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from the WordPress admin area.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the plugin menu and create your first calendar.
  4. Add the calendar shortcode to a page.
sections.changelog:

  • Repository compliance cleanup.
  • Updated text domain and readme metadata.
  • Improved sanitization, escaping and redirect handling.
